name: Arabic Depth Mini Dataset (ADMD)
description: ADMD is a carefully curated evaluation dataset for Arabic language models, containing 490 challenging questions across ten major domains and 42 sub-domains. It measures linguistic accuracy, cultural alignment, and domain-specific knowledge in Arabic LLMs.
reputation: A relatively new Arabic benchmark that is gaining attention in Arabic LLM evaluation, but it is not yet as widely adopted as long-standing multilingual benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on Arabic language model evaluation with emphasis on cultural competence and specialized knowledge.
